messages:
maria: Quick postmortem sync — KV cache eviction spike last night. Capturing test/eval actions here so they don't slip.

sam: Can we get owners + timelines for: regression suite for prefix cache, load test replay, chaos drill?

jordan: I'll own regression prompt sets + prompt-specs. Target EOD Fri for a first draft. :memo:

lee: I'll take the load test replay. Need the raw traffic logs and the replay script.

maria: Logs are in s3://redwood-ops/eviction-2026-03-21 — use evict_replay.py (see infra/scripts). Example:```python
# quick snippet
from replay import EvictReplayer
r = EvictReplayer('s3://redwood-ops/eviction-2026-03-21')
r.run(sample=0.2)
```

ci-bot: Created issue RED-4642 - kv-cache-regression-suite (assignee: lee, due: 2026-04-01)

lee: Added an initial k6 script to infra/tests/kv_replay/k6_kv_replay.js. Will run smoke by Thu and share results. Example run:```bash
k6 run infra/tests/kv_replay/k6_kv_replay.js --vus 50 --duration 10m
```

jordan: For prompt sets: found ~12 prompts that regressed on the eviction case. I'll add them to regression corpus and create an eval scenario named "kv_prefix_misroute".

sam: I'll schedule a chaos drill with oncall rotation for Mon 03:00 PT — can someone confirm availability?

anya: I can be on call for that slot. Also propose adding a weekly cron that runs the key regression against canary builds so we catch regressions earlier.

maria: Action list (summary):
  1) Regression suite + replay (owner: lee) — due 2026-04-01, track RED-4642.
  2) Prompt/eval sets (owner: jordan) — draft by EOD Fri, add scenario "kv_prefix_misroute".
  3) Chaos drill (owners: sam/anya) — scheduled Mon 03:00 PT, oncall roster confirmed.
  4) Weekly cron against canary + alerting (owner: sam) — add to infra schedule and document impact.
  5) Add eviction-rate alert (owner: jordan + ops) — Threshold: eviction_rate > 0.5% over 5m.

lee: :thumbsup: Will link replay script, k6 output and raw logs into RED-4642 once smoke passes.

sam: I'll update the retro doc with these action items and ping infra to reserve GPU nodes for the regression runs.

maria: Can we add an automated step in the eval pipeline that fails a roll if the new regression increases false positive rate on the "kv_prefix_misroute" set by >3%? We need an SLO gate.

jordan: Good call — I'll add an SLO-driven regression check in the PR pipeline and include a small baseline rerun. PR coming.

maria: Great. I'll close this thread once tickets have owners + due dates in RED-4642/RED-4643. Thanks everyone :heart:
